survivors.claim: The replay-worktree marker allow is forgeable by any session: writes into another worktree's private git dir were already fail-open, so an agent can plant the marker in two permitted steps and permanently disable the cross-worktree guard for the main checkout or any sibling worktree.
survivors.impact: Any session that can attempt a blocked cross-worktree write can turn the pollution guard off permanently for the primary checkout; contradicts D1's stated rejection of spoofable mechanisms and the Contracts decision table.
survivors.evidence: Executed against the real hook: wt2->root/README.md exit=2 (blocked); wt2->root/.git/replay-worktree exit=0 (permitted); after touch, wt2->root/README.md exit=0. Sibling variant root/.git/worktrees/wt2/replay-worktree reproduces identically.
